description: The EMS model is an algorithm the authors developed for an earlier study to identify reading sequences from eye-tracking fixation data over look zones.
title: Eye Movement Sequence (EMS) model for identifying reading sequences from fixations

description: A laboratory paradigm in which 59 higher education students read the feedback of two peers on a fictional essay and revise it while their gaze behaviour is recorded.
title: Eye-tracking paradigm for studying peer feedback processing and use

description: The article characterizes an emerging research paradigm in which eye-tracking methodologies are used to study professional vision and teacher expertise.
title: Eye-tracking research paradigm for studying professional vision and teacher expertise

description: The article develops an eyetracking framework for pinpointing the cognitive mechanisms behind improved reasoning.
title: Eyetracking metrics for visual search, relational thinking, and relational integration
